english.title: Sell nicotine inhaling products to person aged under 18
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), sold a nicotine inhaling product, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCT..), to a person aged under 18
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 3 of the Nicotine Inhaling Products (Age of Sale and Proxy Purchasing) Regulations 2015 and section 92(2) and (5) of the Children and Families Act 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 1 of the Nicotine Inhaling Products (Age of Sale and Proxy Purchasing) Regulations 2015 defines 'nicotine inhaling product'.
(ii) Regulation 4 provides an exception for sales of medicines and medical devices in accordance with a prescription.
(iii) Regulation 5 provides an exception for medicines indicated for the treatment of persons aged under 18.
